summary: Wallowa-Whitman lookout near La Grande: a 30-foot pole L-4 tower dated 1937 (1933 reports differ), cupola trailer 1975, gone by 1977.

facts.design: 30-foot pole L-4 tower; AWS cabin added 1942
facts.status_note: Gone by 1977 per the register and firelookout.com

staffing.status: lookout personnel named for 1933, 1940 and 1942; no end-of-staffing date in these sources

events.note: Baker Democrat-Herald (Sept 13, 1933) reported a 14x14 lookout house on a 35-foot tower; Record-Courier (Sept 21, 1933) said 30 feet. Sources do not say whether this is the 1937 tower.
Dean Bidwell to have charge of the station that summer (Baker Democrat Herald, July 21, 1933)
Register and firelookout.com date a 30-foot pole L-4 tower to 1937
Neil Taylor named as lookout, per firelookout.com
Maurice Larive named as lookout, per firelookout.com
Cupola trailer set up on the site
Gone by 1977 per the register and firelookout.com

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register and firelookout.com date a 30-foot pole L-4 tower to 1937. Local papers from September 1933 describe a 14x14 lookout house being built on a 30- or 35-foot tower. The sources disagree and the story says so.

sources.title: Anthony Butte
sources.publisher: Forest Lookouts (Oregon), Rex's Fire Lookout Page

notes_for_editor: Built year conflicts: register and firelookout.com say 1937 for a 30-foot tower; Rex's page quotes two September 1933 papers describing a 14x14 house on a 30- or 35-foot tower. The story reports both. The record's height was 4.3 m, which matches no source; it is now 9.1 m (30 ft), as the register and firelookout.com give. A reviewer should confirm the height convention used for the record. No source describes what remains on the summit today, and none gives access, so those keys are omitted. Two web searches found no independent history for this lookout beyond the listing and location. An Umatilla NF Desolation Butte result was off-topic and excluded.
